{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''courier''' working with a crime syndicate on the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

The courier and their [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian partner|partner]] often stayed at a [[Bothan hotel]], few days each time, and had the custom of eating in their own room.

The courier was in possession of a briefcase, the contents of which competing criminal groups were willing to [[Death/Legends|kill]] for, a fate that befell their [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian partner|partner]]. A [[Unidentified man (gravely voice)|man]] had paid the courier 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] upfront, and promised to pay the same amount after the courier delivered the briefcase in their meeting in [[Drev'starn]].

The [[Courier/Legends|courier]] became enveloped in a case of mistaken identity when a group of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[operative]]s arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Unidentified courier lookalike|one of whom]] coincidentally happened to have an identical physical appearance. 

The night the Rodian partner was murdered, the courier went to the [[Stone Grotto]] alone, hiding the much-coveted briefcase under the table. Two well-dressed Rodians, came and seized the criminal, claiming the briefcase.

The Rebels also had found a lead to that place and witnessed the hostage situation as it erupted into chaos. When the Rebels tried to intervene, [[Unidentified Rodian kidnapper|one of the kidnappers]] brandished a [[thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and threatened to destroy the entire club, attempting to grab along the unfortunate look-alike. 

Just as their escape seemed certain, [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] police forces stormed the area, sealing off the streets outside and forcing the desperate kidnappers into a final, dangerous standoff inside the club. Ultimately, the courier was apprehended by local Bothan [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]].

==Behind the scenes==
The adventure leaves open the courier's [[Gender/Legends|sex]] and [[Species/Legends|species]], contingent on the Rebel player who serves as the courier lookalike. Additionally, following the courier's apprehension, the adventure offers a possible scenario for continuing the events, suggesting that the courier may have actually been an undercover agent for a megacorporation who was performing a sting operation that went awry.
